description: Pure Engine policy slice stacked after #811. Add a typed facts contract and code-defined Direct/Shared/Replicated strategies with validated transcript coordinates, per-message association targets, access policy hints, parent-context source order and membership lifecycle. Reject unknown provider/connector/kind, nil actor where required, inconsistent parent and mismatched connector. Provider defaults must be explicit; mention/response gating belongs to .4, not history. Test FIRST: Direct one-to-one participant grants; Shared root/thread inheritance and read order; Replicated per-message sender/recipient sets with no retroactive association, unknown mapping and collision isolation; property tests for uniqueness and membership safety. No DB persistence or Action exposure. Read Engine and Channels guides, docs/action-reuse.md/testing-approach.md; update Engine guide. No E2E authoring before human UX approval.
title: [zaq-emb.14.1] Define typed Engine history strategies
